text:
ashley: Quick follow-up from last night's paging noise + S3 uploader flaps — wanted to capture action items and owners. Root causes: noisy duplicate alerts from our old dedupe rule + a too-sensitive latency threshold on the uploader job.

kevin: I can own the dedupe rule rewrite. targeting EOD Fri for PR + tests.

ashley: perfect — please include an example alert grouping key and a short rationale in the PR. also update the runbook.

kevin: will do. plan: switch from host-based group_key to job+bucket+error_type, 30s suppression, 10m rolling window. PR when ready.

sam: I'll take the threshold smoothing/aggregation work. can you paste the current query? want to propose moving median + p99 smoothing to cut noisey spikes.

ashley: current alert: `avg_over_time(uploader_latency[2m]) > 1.2` — suggestion: use a 5m moving median + p99 on request_latency bucketed by job. something like:
```
alert: uploader_latency_high
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job)) > 1.0
for: 3m
```
This should reduce single-request spikes.

lee: paging policy thought: only escalate to oncall if there are alerts from >=2 distinct job groups OR >=3 pages in 15m. also add a 10m suppression per incident id to avoid repeat pages.

maria: happy to own runbook updates and the incident template. I'll add remediation steps, rollback checks, and a checklist for dedupe/threshold changes. target Tue next week.

aj: small caution — when deduping by job+bucket make sure we include region label; we previously hid multi-region issues by grouping too broadly. prefer job+bucket+region.

kevin: good call, will add region. group_key = job + bucket + region + error_type.

ashley: summary & owners (please confirm):
- Dedupe rule rewrite: kevin — ETA Fri EOD (PR + tests + staging validation)
- Threshold smoothing & query change: sam — ETA next Wed (benchmarks + eval on traffic)
- Runbook & incident template: maria — ETA Tue next week
- Paging policy update & suppression windows: lee — ETA next Thu
- Quick follow-up sync: ashley to run, timeline below

kevin: confirmed.

sam: confirmed, will post query diffs to the thread.

maria: confirmed.

oncall-bot: Calendar event created: "Alert tuning follow-up" Wed 14:00 UTC — attendees: #eng-oncall. Reminder 30m prior.

ashley: thanks all. please drop PR links / grafana dashboard snapshots here when ready. if you need to shift deadlines ping me directly. :pray:

lee: adding a demo of the new suppression build to staging after kevin's PR merges. will validate that we still surface true positives. :thumbsup:

ashley: ok — we'll close this thread after the sync if all signoffs are in.
